openings.claim: An ambiguity-only conversion/revision interface may preserve defensible reconciliation under damaged linkage. Disable the supersession-edge join into normalized-row eligibility; never reconstruct it. Convert every recorded quantity, retaining original units and citations. Keep the revision register linking supplied amendments to their specific superseded records, passing only per-batch completeness/ambiguity flags, never replacement identities or exclusion instructions.
openings.discriminator: Against a conventional joined ledger checking row identifiers and effective times, the candidate may yield fewer unsupported definite claims after disturbance but more bounded disagreements. A conservative rival could tie or outperform it. Defeat: the rival is equally conservative, correctly resolves more batches, or the candidate introduces unsupported definiteness.
openings.probe: Run both workflows on intact and disturbed copies (one removed superseded-row reference and one undefined status). Freeze all twelve batch outputs before opening the sealed key; compare correct resolved batches, unsupported definite claims and request counts. Return a common quantity only if every recorded normalized quantity agrees and eligibility is unambiguous; otherwise cite finite recorded candidates and eligibility uncertainty. Preserve every duplicate/unmatched row. Use only U=5V, supplied dictionary and cutoffs; never infer from neighboring batches. Issue at most three requests naming demonstrably missing fields/records, including superseded-row reference or undefined-status meaning; retain remaining disagreements. Review cap: sixty minutes; four-run comparison cap: twenty extra minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Two separate ledgers are permitted; actual values and timing are unprovided. The amendment effective before both cutoffs and older replacement under a different identifier remain explicit uncertainty, never invented equivalence. Capacity defeat: twelve cited outputs exceed sixty minutes or four-run comparison exceeds twenty extra minutes; caps prove no feasibility. Hypothetical probe, no deployment or observed gain.

lineage.reason: Preserves both parent functions, disabled linkage, declared fit, rival predictions, defeats, constraints and uncertainties.

decision: Retain as an untested candidate; benefit and timing remain unmeasured, and conservative disagreement may reduce useful resolution.
